subcommands.name: create-cell
subcommands.description: Creates a cell in an account.

subcommands.name: create-cross-account-authorization
subcommands.description: Creates a cross-account readiness authorization.

subcommands.name: create-readiness-check
subcommands.description: Creates a readiness check in an account.

subcommands.name: create-recovery-group
subcommands.description: Creates a recovery group in an account.

subcommands.name: create-resource-set
subcommands.description: Creates a resource set.

subcommands.name: delete-cell
subcommands.description: Delete a cell.

subcommands.name: delete-cross-account-authorization
subcommands.description: Deletes cross account readiness authorization.

subcommands.name: delete-readiness-check
subcommands.description: Deletes a readiness check.

subcommands.name: delete-recovery-group
subcommands.description: Deletes a recovery group.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-set
subcommands.description: Deletes a resource set.

subcommands.name: get-architecture-recommendations
subcommands.description: Gets recommendations about architecture designs for improving resiliency for an application, based on a recovery group.

subcommands.name: get-cell
subcommands.description: Gets information about a cell including cell name, cell Amazon Resource Name (ARN), ARNs of nested cells for this cell, and a list of those cell ARNs with their associated recovery group ARNs.

subcommands.name: get-cell-readiness-summary
subcommands.description: Gets readiness for a cell.

subcommands.name: get-readiness-check
subcommands.description: Gets details about a readiness check.

subcommands.name: get-readiness-check-resource-status
subcommands.description: Gets individual readiness status for a readiness check.

subcommands.name: get-readiness-check-status
subcommands.description: Gets the readiness status for an individual readiness check.

subcommands.name: get-recovery-group
subcommands.description: Gets details about a recovery group, including a list of the cells that are included in it.

subcommands.name: get-recovery-group-readiness-summary
subcommands.description: Displays a summary of information about a recovery group's readiness status.

subcommands.name: get-resource-set
subcommands.description: Displays the details about a resource set, including a list of the resources in the set.

subcommands.name: list-cells
subcommands.description: Lists the cells for an account.

subcommands.name: list-cross-account-authorizations
subcommands.description: Lists the cross-account readiness authorizations that are in place for an account.

subcommands.name: list-readiness-checks
subcommands.description: Lists the readiness checks for an account.

subcommands.name: list-recovery-groups
subcommands.description: Lists the recovery groups in an account.

subcommands.name: list-resource-sets
subcommands.description: Lists the resource sets in an account.

subcommands.name: list-rules
subcommands.description: Lists all readiness rules, or lists the readiness rules for a specific resource type.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resources
subcommands.description: Lists the tags for a resource.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds a tag to a resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a tag from a resource.

subcommands.name: update-cell
subcommands.description: Updates a cell to replace the list of nested cells with a new list of nested cells.

subcommands.name: update-readiness-check
subcommands.description: Updates a readiness check.

subcommands.name: update-recovery-group
subcommands.description: Updates a recovery group.

subcommands.name: update-resource-set
subcommands.description: Updates a resource set.
